scope: Save exact case plan before writes; one bounded read actual own8controls/fonts and required published Link variants
One batch reconfigures the same8roots/captions: allHUG, Bottom enabled/PresetsLink/LabelПодробнее, specified Size/RightAddon; keep all IDs, no newroots or explicit removals
Icon cases preserve legal Shape=true/BgColor=false configuration through actual public ports; BG cases TypeSecondary; no raw paint/font/mode changes
One ownboard screenshot, publicproperty readback in batch, actualfonts loaded before relevant mutations; STOP/preserve on failure, no autoretry
Report expected target-parent outcomes, inherited Draft child unknowns separately; no claim of zero total diagnostics or Ready

privateReplay.inputs: Only8 already-pinned owner reports plus exact r10/3child authored ZIPs
privateReplay.operation: Existing canonical authored ZIP import/build, exact child pin correspondence, validatedDependencyCapture then transient standalone authoring preview/evaluation
forbidden: Manual compatibility stamps or custom extractor
Persisted status or dependency pin changes
Conflating old retained snapshots with newly prepared cases
privateReplay.onFailure: Save namedgap and stop replay branch; no new platform pipeline

handoff: After new owner reports independently accepted, closed mapping-input handoff may be sent to Mapping under direct owner authorization. Draft/open child gaps explicit; no automatic Apollo integration.
